title: kbmon judges an orphan process and a low disk as snapshot alerts
goal: kbmon's snapshot holds an orphan alert (kind orphan, id sessions.orphan) while the sessions panel lists an orphan process and a disk alert (kind disk, id host.disk) while the clone's file system has under 10% free; the host panel's data gains disk with free_bytes, total_bytes and free_pct

run:
import json,subprocess as s,sys
p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--panel','host','--timeout','30'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
p.returncode in (0,1) or (print('exit',p.returncode,p.stderr[-300:]),sys.exit(1))
h=json.loads(p.stdout)['panels']['host'];d=(h.get('data') or {}).get('disk') or {}
ok=h['state']=='ok' and isinstance(d.get('free_pct'),(int,float)) and 0<=d['free_pct']<=100 and d.get('total_bytes',0)>0 and d.get('free_bytes',-1)>=0
print(d);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

clauses.clause: kbmon's snapshot holds an orphan alert (kind orphan, id sessions.orphan) while the sessions panel lists an orphan process and a disk alert (kind disk, id host.disk) while the clone's file system has under 10% free
the host panel's data gains disk with free_bytes, total_bytes and free_pct

notes: Plan 2026-10-19: premise run on the base: a planted snapshot with an orphan process and 3% free disk judges no alert (alerts [] exit 0), and the host panel has no disk data. The sessions panel listed 2-4 real orphans during the session. The receipt (ST-nighxizj) and the pane read these alerts.
